chart_specs.description: AUC, Brier, ECE, precision and recall of each variant against the pair labels.
chart_specs.title: Duplicate detection performance by variant

description: Do System One duplicate judgments beat a deterministic lexical baseline on pairs drawn from a software project tracker?
hypothesis: System One P(redundant) separates labeled duplicate pairs from labeled non-duplicate pairs better than the deterministic lexical-similarity baseline.

legend.auc: area under the ROC curve against the pair label
legend.brier: mean squared error of P(redundant) against the pair label
legend.ece: expected calibration error of P(redundant) in ten equal-width bins
legend.jev-latest: System One duplicate judgments from the jev-latest model
legend.one_covers_other: One is a broader or later version that fully includes the other's work.
legend.precision: precision of P(redundant) at a 0.5 threshold
legend.recall: recall of P(redundant) at a 0.5 threshold
legend.related_distinct: Same area or feature, but each requires separate work.
legend.same_work: Both ask for essentially the same change or investigation.
legend.unrelated: Different areas; doing one says nothing about the other.

provenance.detail: dupes.py build() labels lines 85-119, run() lines 146-166, report() lines 174-195; scan.py reuses dupes.questions() at line 130
